integrity: Exact symbolic proof using commuting-module coordinates and t-adic valuation, with independent finite-instance matrix arithmetic reproduction; the finite tests do not establish the infinite-dimensional claims.
scientific_limitations: A fixed nilpotent Jordan partition (n,1), n>=2; counts matrices rather than centralizer-group orbits. The geometry describes reduced varieties only. Prior representation-theoretic literature could contain an equivalent enumeration under different language.
title: Parity geometry and rank spectra of square-zero commutants of an almost-regular nilpotent
